copy.curiosityHook: Locked beneath the surface with the manuscript of the year, how secure can a high-stakes secret remain among nine rivals confined together?
copy.description: Hired to translate the eagerly anticipated final volume of a global bestselling trilogy, nine linguists are sequestered inside a luxurious underground bunker to keep the literary sensation under complete lock and key.
copy.vibeSummary: A tense, stylish, and thoughtful locked-room thriller that demands steady attention without crushing emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: Régis Roinsard turns a publishing deadline into a sleek, multilingual mystery-thriller, trapping an ensemble cast in an opulent pressure cooker built on secrets and intellect.

allowedMaterial: Nine translators hired for the final book of a bestselling trilogy
Confinement within a luxurious bunker to protect the manuscript
Régis Roinsard's direction and mystery-thriller genre frame
excludedMaterial: Identity of any leakers or blackmailers
Plot leaks, ransom demands, or manuscript theft details
Character deaths, betrayals, or physical violence
